_what_this_is: Human labels for the generated answers of ONE run. Ground truth for comparing graders, which is the only thing it is for. Produced by reading each answer beside its grade, which is how the boundary bug in finding 13 was caught.

_labels.correct: The model asserted the right answer.
_labels.wrong: The model asserted something false, or the right figure for the wrong entity, or refused while holding the answer in its context.
_labels.refused: The model declined. Counted as correct behaviour when retrieval never put the answer in the top 3, because that failure is already measured by fact-level hit@3 and counting it here would count it twice.

_pinned_to_run.caveat: temperature, top_p and top_k are all deprecated on claude-sonnet-5, so generation is not reproducible. See finding 17. A re-run produces different answers and these labels may no longer describe them. Check model_answer against the new output before reusing a label. If source_fingerprint no longer matches results.json, the code changed too.
